protocol.notes: All parameters are benchmark assumptions. Matched closed-system synthetic distribution. No robustness or sensor calibration claim.

detector_generation: CPU NumPy binomial projection then conditional Poisson sampling
timing_definition: Synchronized wall time; evolutions include operator preparation and implicit Hamiltonian uploads. Explicit state uploads/downloads are separate sub-timings. Process elapsed begins at first Python statement, not interpreter startup.

cudaq_environment.evolve_signature: (hamiltonian: 'Operator | SuperOperator | Sequence[Operator] | Sequence[SuperOperator]', dimensions: 'Mapping[int, int]' = {}, schedule: 'Schedule' = None, initial_state: 'InitialStateArgT | Sequence[InitialStateArgT]' = None, collapse_operators: 'Sequence[Operator] | Sequence[Sequence[Operator]]' = [], observables: 'Sequence[Operator]' = [], store_intermediate_results: 'IntermediateResultSave | bool' = <IntermediateResultSave.NONE: 1>, integrator: 'Optional[BaseIntegrator]' = None, shots_count: 'Optional[int]' = None, max_batch_size: 'Optional[int]' = None) -> 'cudaq_runtime.EvolveResult | Sequence[cudaq_runtime.EvolveResult]'

integer_expected_outputs: Frozen CPU integer reference; C independent replay validation required separately.

gpu_memory.method: CUDA memGetInfo and CuPy pool at synchronized stage checkpoints; CUDA-Q allocations are not all in the CuPy pool. Device free-memory changes are device-wide and sampled, not an allocation peak or exclusive process usage. Unified host RAM availability is not GPU allocation.
